card.name: Words just before money or revenue
card.fires_on: Words right before an expected noun like money, income or revenue, such as earn, earned, lost, extra, make, or "source of". It marks places where a money word is about to come next.

modes.label: Earning verbs
modes.description: Verbs about earning or making a living, just before income or money.
modes.example: He<< earned>> his living as a cafe musician; his

modes.label: Modifier or "of" before revenue
modes.description: A modifier or "of" that leads into revenue, money, or foreign exchange.
modes.example: costs governments billions of dollars in<< lost>> revenue

card.writes: It promotes money-related words such as income, revenue and money, and suppresses unrelated tokens.
